# Configuration reference

Both programs read one YAML file (`--config`, or `SPACEMAN_CONFIG` / `SPACEMAN_AGENT_CONFIG`) and then environment
overrides. Unknown keys and unknown override variables are rejected, so a typo stops the program instead of being
ignored. Every problem is reported at once. Secrets never go in the file: the KEK, TLS keys, S3 keys and Pulse
credentials are read from the files named here.

- **Central** (`spaceman serve`, `spaceman backup`): overrides are `SPACEMAN_<PATH>`, e.g. `SPACEMAN_HTTP_LISTEN=:8443`. Lists are
  comma-separated. Variables of the node agent (`SPACEMAN_AGENT_*`) and of the command-line client
  (`SPACEMAN_SERVER`, `SPACEMAN_TOKEN`, `SPACEMAN_TOKEN_FILE`, `SPACEMAN_OUTPUT`, `SPACEMAN_SPACE`, `SPACEMAN_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP`), of `spaceman-agent enroll` (`SPACEMAN_ENROLL_TOKEN`) and of the Terraform
  provider (`SPACEMAN_ENDPOINT`) are ignored.
- **Node agent** (`spaceman-agent`): overrides are `SPACEMAN_AGENT_<PATH>`.
- **Durations** are Go duration strings: `30s`, `15m`, `24h`.

Annotated examples: `deploy/examples/spaceman.example.yaml`, `deploy/examples/spaceman.container.yaml` and
`deploy/examples/agent.example.yaml` ([installation](/operators/install)). Limits set here are installation defaults;
spaces override them ([limits and budgets](/guide/limits)).

## Central (`spaceman`)

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `production` | `SPACEMAN_MODE` | "production" (default) or "development". Development mode allows plain http, disabling TOTP, shorter passwords and other relaxations that production rejects. |
| `data_dir` | `/var/lib/spaceman` | `SPACEMAN_DATA_DIR` | Holds the database, artifacts and backups by default. Absolute, on a local filesystem (network filesystems are refused); created 0700. |
| `public_url` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_PUBLIC_URL` | The URL browsers and nodes use to reach central (required; https in production). |

### `kek`

Locates the master key-encryption key.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kek.source` | `file` | `SPACEMAN_KEK_SOURCE` | "file" (default) or "env" (reads base64 from SPACEMAN_KEK; discouraged). |
| `kek.file` | `/etc/spaceman/kek` | `SPACEMAN_KEK_FILE` | The KEK file (absolute in production). Keep it outside data_dir, readable only by central, and back it up offline apart from the backups: without it backups and secrets cannot be decrypted. |

### `http`

Configures the web/API listener and the separate management listener (SM-OBS-002).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `http.listen` | `:8080` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_LISTEN` | The host:port of the web UI, API and node connections. |
| `http.management_listen` | `127.0.0.1:9090` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_MANAGEMENT_LISTEN` | Serves /healthz, /readyz and /metrics only (empty: disabled). It is unauthenticated: keep it private. It must differ from listen. |
| `http.tls_cert_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_TLS_CERT_FILE` | The TLS certificate (PEM). With tls_key_file (set together) central terminates TLS itself; otherwise terminate it at a reverse proxy. |
| `http.tls_key_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_TLS_KEY_FILE` | The private key for tls_cert_file. |
| `http.trusted_proxies` | `[]` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | Lists the CIDR prefixes of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For is trusted; other peers' headers are ignored. |
| `http.max_body_bytes` | `1048576` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | Bounds one API request body (attachment uploads have their own bound). |
| `http.max_upload_bytes` | `26214400` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | Bounds one attachment upload (SM-ATT-002). |
| `http.read_header_timeout` | `10s` | `SPACEMAN_HTTP_READ_HEADER_TIMEOUT` | Bounds how long a client may take to send request headers. |

### `log`

Selects the log level (debug, info, warn, error) and format (json, text).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `log.level` | `info` | `SPACEMAN_LOG_LEVEL` | One of debug, info, warn or error. |
| `log.format` | `json` | `SPACEMAN_LOG_FORMAT` | One of json (ECS-aligned) or text. Logs go to stderr (the journal under systemd). |

### `auth`

Configures operator authentication (SM-AUTH-001).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.session_idle` | `30m0s` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_SESSION_IDLE` | Ends a browser session after this much inactivity (1m to 24h). |
| `auth.session_absolute` | `12h0m0s` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_SESSION_ABSOLUTE` | Ends a browser session this long after sign-in, whatever its activity (session_idle to 720h). |
| `auth.reauth_window` | `5m0s` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_REAUTH_WINDOW` | How long a step-up re-authentication counts for sensitive actions (1m to 1h). |
| `auth.password_min_length` | `12` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH` | The shortest password accepted (at least 12 in production). |
| `auth.require_totp` | `true` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_REQUIRE_TOTP` | Makes TOTP mandatory for every password account. Production requires it; privileged accounts need TOTP even in development mode. |
| `auth.local_login_disabled` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_LOCAL_LOGIN_DISABLED` | Accepted but not read: password sign-in is turned off (SSO-only) at run time on the Sign-in providers page or with `spaceman oidc settings set --sso-only`, which first checks that a tested provider and an administrator who can sign in with SSO exist (ADR-0045). |
| `auth.stream_revalidate` | `30s` | `SPACEMAN_AUTH_STREAM_REVALIDATE` | How often an open live stream (change feed, terminal) and a node connection re-check their credential and authorization. Revocations committed by central end affected streams at once; this interval bounds everything else (expiry, idle timeout, changes made while central was stopped). 1 s to 60 s, default 30 s (SM-AUTH-007, ADR-0033). |

### `nodes`

Configures node connectivity and execution leases (ADR-0006).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes.heartbeat_interval` | `10s` | `SPACEMAN_NODES_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` | How often a connected node reports in and renews its leases (1s to 1m). |
| `nodes.lease_ttl` | `45s` | `SPACEMAN_NODES_LEASE_TTL` | How long one renewal of a space's execution lease is valid (at least 3x heartbeat_interval, at most 10m). |
| `nodes.disconnect_grace` | `2m0s` | `SPACEMAN_NODES_DISCONNECT_GRACE` | How long a node keeps runs going after losing central before stopping them (SM-NODE-007; 0 to 1h). |
| `nodes.enrollment_ttl` | `24h0m0s` | `SPACEMAN_NODES_ENROLLMENT_TTL` | How long a node enrollment token stays valid (1m to 720h). |
| `nodes.command_timeout` | `30s` | `SPACEMAN_NODES_COMMAND_TIMEOUT` | Validated (1s to 10m) but not read by this build; node commands use their own fixed timeouts. |

### `artifacts`

Selects the artifact store (SM-STORE-002, ADR-0048): where attachment content, central's copies of recordings and run transcripts are kept.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifacts.backend` | `local` | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_BACKEND` | "local" (default: attachments in local_dir, recordings and transcripts in &lt;data_dir&gt;) or "s3" (the bucket in s3; recordings being shipped and transcripts being received are spooled in &lt;data_dir&gt; until complete). Switching backends does not move stored artifacts: stop central and run `spaceman artifacts migrate`. |
| `artifacts.local_dir` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_LOCAL_DIR` | The local backend's attachment directory (default &lt;data_dir&gt;/artifacts); with s3 it holds the upload spool (tmp/). |
| `artifacts.s3.endpoint` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_ENDPOINT` | The S3 API endpoint URL (required for s3). |
| `artifacts.s3.region` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_REGION` | The bucket's region. |
| `artifacts.s3.bucket` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_BUCKET` | The bucket name (required for s3). |
| `artifacts.s3.prefix` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_PREFIX` | Prepended to every object key. |
| `artifacts.s3.access_key_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` | Holds the access key ID (an absolute path, required with secret_key_file). |
| `artifacts.s3.secret_key_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_SECRET_KEY_FILE` | Holds the secret access key. |
| `artifacts.s3.use_path_style` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE` | Addresses the bucket in the path instead of the host name (MinIO and most self-hosted stores). |
| `artifacts.s3.insecure_allowed` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_INSECURE_ALLOWED` | Permits a plain http endpoint (development mode only). |
| `artifacts.s3.allow_private_network` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK` | Lets the endpoint resolve to a private, loopback or link-local address (self-hosted MinIO). |
| `artifacts.s3.ca_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_S3_CA_FILE` | Adds trust roots (PEM) for the endpoint; verification is never disabled. |
| `artifacts.space_quota_bytes` | `1073741824` | `SPACEMAN_ARTIFACTS_SPACE_QUOTA_BYTES` | Bounds the attachments stored per space (SM-ATT-002). |

### `harness`

Holds policy ceilings applied to every launch, whatever layer set the value (SM-PROMPT-003).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `harness.max_permission_mode` | `auto` | `SPACEMAN_HARNESS_MAX_PERMISSION_MODE` | The most permissive Claude Code permission mode a run may get: plan, default, dontAsk, acceptEdits, auto (default) or bypassPermissions. A higher mode from a profile, role or launch is lowered to it. |

### `events`

Configures SpaceMan's own outbound events. Inbound Pulse connections and subscriptions are managed through the API, not here (SM-OBS-005).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `events.outbound.enabled` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_ENABLED` | Turns publication on (needs url and creds_file). |
| `events.outbound.url` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_URL` | The Pulse NATS URL: tls://host:port (required in production) or nats://host:port. |
| `events.outbound.creds_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_CREDS_FILE` | The Pulse client .creds file (user JWT and nkey seed) with a publish:evt.spaceman.&gt; grant. |
| `events.outbound.ca_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_CA_FILE` | An optional extra CA bundle (PEM) for tls:// URLs. |
| `events.outbound.source` | `spaceman` | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_SOURCE` | The ce-source and the spaceman-origin header (default "spaceman"); give each installation its own. |
| `events.outbound.retention` | `168h0m0s` | `SPACEMAN_EVENTS_OUTBOUND_RETENTION` | How long published and dead-lettered events are kept (default 168h). |

### `backups`

Configures where central keeps backups and the backup schedule (SM-STORE-005, ADR-0031). Manual backups (API, UI, CLI) use the same target whether or not the schedule is enabled.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `backups.enabled` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_ENABLED` | Turns the schedule on: one backup every interval, then retention. |
| `backups.interval` | `24h0m0s` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_INTERVAL` | The time between scheduled backups (15m to 168h). |
| `backups.keep_last` | `7` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_KEEP_LAST` | How many complete backups retention keeps at least (the newest ones; 1-1000). |
| `backups.max_age` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_MAX_AGE` | Deletes backups older than this beyond the newest one (0 keeps them, bounded by keep_last only). |
| `backups.target` | `local` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_TARGET` | "local" (default) or "s3". |
| `backups.local_dir` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_LOCAL_DIR` | The local target directory (default &lt;data_dir&gt;/backups). Prefer another disk. |
| `backups.s3.endpoint` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_ENDPOINT` | The S3 API endpoint URL (required for s3). |
| `backups.s3.region` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_REGION` | The bucket's region. |
| `backups.s3.bucket` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_BUCKET` | The bucket name (required for s3). |
| `backups.s3.prefix` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_PREFIX` | Prepended to every object key. |
| `backups.s3.access_key_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_FILE` | Holds the access key ID (an absolute path, required with secret_key_file). |
| `backups.s3.secret_key_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_SECRET_KEY_FILE` | Holds the secret access key. |
| `backups.s3.use_path_style` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_USE_PATH_STYLE` | Addresses the bucket in the path instead of the host name (MinIO and most self-hosted stores). |
| `backups.s3.insecure_allowed` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_INSECURE_ALLOWED` | Permits a plain http endpoint (development mode only). |
| `backups.s3.allow_private_network` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK` | Lets the endpoint resolve to a private, loopback or link-local address (self-hosted MinIO). |
| `backups.s3.ca_file` | (empty) | `SPACEMAN_BACKUPS_S3_CA_FILE` | Adds trust roots (PEM) for the endpoint; verification is never disabled. |

### `limits`

Holds the installation defaults of the limits model (SM-LIMIT-001, ADR-0036). Spaces override them through the API or UI; the effective value of each limit, and where it comes from, is shown per space. The attachment storage quota stays artifacts.space_quota_bytes. 0 means "no limit" where the field says so.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limits.max_concurrent_runs` | `8` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS` | Bounds the worker and diagnostic runs of one space that may be active at once (1-256, default 8). Control, KB support and dreamer runs have their own pools and never count against it. |
| `limits.max_top_level_tasks` | `1` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_TOP_LEVEL_TASKS` | The default queue limit of top-level tasks running at once (1-20, default 1); a space's queue policy overrides it. |
| `limits.max_kb_sessions` | `8` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_KB_SESSIONS` | Bounds the active KB support sessions of one space across all its knowledge bases (1-64, default 8), on top of each knowledge base's own max_sessions. |
| `limits.support_depth` | `1` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_SUPPORT_DEPTH` | How deep support may nest (1-3, default 1): at 1 a KB support session cannot ask a knowledge base, so support never starts more support. |
| `limits.max_human_pending` | `500` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_HUMAN_PENDING` | Bounds the open human actions of one space (1-5000, default 500). |
| `limits.max_human_pending_per_run` | `25` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_HUMAN_PENDING_PER_RUN` | Bounds the open human actions one agent run may have asked (1-500, default 25). |
| `limits.max_tool_calls_per_run` | `5000` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_MAX_TOOL_CALLS_PER_RUN` | Bounds the SpaceMan and gateway tool calls of one run (0: no limit; default 5000). |
| `limits.ingest_per_minute` | `600` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_INGEST_PER_MINUTE` | Bounds the events one subscription ingests per minute (1-60000, default 600); the rest waits in the stream. |
| `limits.event_depth` | `8` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_EVENT_DEPTH` | Bounds automation across installations (1-64, default 8): an inbound event whose spaceman-depth header says it already passed through this many SpaceMan ingestions is quarantined instead of becoming an inbox item, so an event loop between installations ends (SM-EVT-016, ADR-0049). |
| `limits.task_deadline_minutes` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_TASK_DEADLINE_MINUTES` | How long a top-level task may run before control and the operators are told (0: no deadline; at most 43200). A passed deadline never stops the task. |
| `limits.budget_tokens_24h` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_BUDGET_TOKENS_24H` | A space's token budget over the last 24 hours (input plus output tokens of runs started in that window; 0: none). Usage is reported late, so this warns and stops new runs; it is not a hard limit. |
| `limits.budget_cost_cents_24h` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_BUDGET_COST_CENTS_24H` | A space's estimated-cost budget over the last 24 hours in US cents (0: none). Estimates come from the harnesses and arrive late: never a hard currency limit. |
| `limits.budget_tokens_per_run` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_BUDGET_TOKENS_PER_RUN` | Warns when one run's reported tokens pass it (0: none). Runs are never stopped for it. |
| `limits.budget_warn_percent` | `80` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_BUDGET_WARN_PERCENT` | When a budget warning is sent (1-100, default 80). |
| `limits.retention_recordings_days` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_RETENTION_RECORDINGS_DAYS` | Deletes central's copy of a run's terminal recording this many days after the run ended (0: keep until deleted or the space is purged, the default; at most 36500). The node's local copy is separate. |
| `limits.retention_transcripts_days` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_RETENTION_TRANSCRIPTS_DAYS` | Deletes a run's stored native transcript this many days after it was stored (0: keep). |
| `limits.retention_attachments_days` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_RETENTION_ATTACHMENTS_DAYS` | Deletes attachments older than this many days once every item that uses them is finished (done or rejected inbox items without an open task or human action). An attachment that an open item uses is never deleted (0: keep). Unreferenced uploads are collected after a day regardless. |
| `limits.retention_human_actions_days` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_RETENTION_HUMAN_ACTIONS_DAYS` | Deletes finished human actions (resolved, cancelled, expired) this many days after they finished, with their comments and notifications, unless an open task, an open follow-up or an undelivered response still refers to them (0: keep). |
| `limits.recording_quota_bytes` | `536870912` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_RECORDING_QUOTA_BYTES` | Bounds one run's terminal recording on the node (1 MiB-64 GiB, default 512 MiB). When it is reached the recording ends with a truncation record; the run is unaffected. |
| `limits.export_max_bytes` | `2147483648` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_EXPORT_MAX_BYTES` | Bounds one space export archive (1 MiB-64 GiB, default 2 GiB): a larger export is refused. |
| `limits.control_autostart` | `1` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_CONTROL_AUTOSTART` | Starts a space's control role when work arrives for control and no control run is live (1: on, the default; 0: off). It is skipped while the space is paused and when the launch is refused (no control role, account or budget); at most 6 starts an hour per space (ADR-0056). |
| `limits.control_idle_stop_minutes` | `30` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_CONTROL_IDLE_STOP_MINUTES` | Stops a control run that has been idle this long (finished its turn, nothing waiting for it, no operator at its terminal); the next event starts it again, resuming its session (0: never; default 30; at most 10080). |
| `limits.terminal_cols` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_TERMINAL_COLS` | The width new runs' terminals are held at (ADR-0075): 40-400 columns, or 0 (the default) for the node's runner.terminal_size. A size applies only when terminal_rows is set too. |
| `limits.terminal_rows` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_LIMITS_TERMINAL_ROWS` | The height new runs' terminals are held at: 10-200 rows, or 0 (the default) for the node's runner.terminal_size. A size applies only when terminal_cols is set too. |

### `retention`

Holds the installation-wide retention that cannot be set per space (ADR-0045). Per-space retention periods are limits (limits.retention_*_days, overridable per space); one daily pass applies them all.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `retention.audit_days` | `0` | `SPACEMAN_RETENTION_AUDIT_DAYS` | Deletes audit events older than this many days in the daily retention pass (0: keep forever, the default; otherwise 30-36500). The hash chain keeps verifying from the first retained event, and a reader whose cursor is older is told that events were pruned. Audit is installation-wide: it cannot be set per space. |

### `shutdown`

Bounds graceful shutdown.

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shutdown.timeout` | `30s` | `SPACEMAN_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | How long central waits for requests and background work to finish on stop (1s to 10m). Keep it below the service manager's stop timeout. |

## Node agent (`spaceman-agent`)

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `production` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_MODE` | "production" (default) or "development" (allows a plain http central URL). |

### `runner`

Configures the herdr-core runner (ADR-0007).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `runner.hc_binary` | `hc` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_RUNNER_HC_BINARY` | The herdr-core client binary ("hc"). |
| `runner.session` | `spaceman` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_RUNNER_SESSION` | The dedicated hc session (lowercase token); never the operator's "default" core. |

| `runner.terminal_size` | `160x48` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_RUNNER_TERMINAL_SIZE` | The size programs start at, COLSxROWS (default 160x48; herdr-core's own default is 200x120). Watch-only viewers never resize a program, so this is the size agents lay out for. Programs already running keep their size. |

| `harness.claude.cache_keep` | `3` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_HARNESS_CLAUDE_CACHE_KEEP` | How many of the newest versions the cache keeps besides pinned and in-use ones (1-50). |
| `harness.claude.refresh` | `15m0s` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_HARNESS_CLAUDE_REFRESH` | How long a channel is memoised and how often the node re-resolves and prefetches it (1m to 24h). |
| `harness.claude.download_timeout` | `15m0s` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_HARNESS_CLAUDE_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT` | Bounds one version download (30s to 2h). |
| `harness.claude.self_update` | `false` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_HARNESS_CLAUDE_SELF_UPDATE` | Lets Claude Code update itself in runs. Off (default) is meant to give runs DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1; not acted on by this build. |

### `log`

Selects the log level (debug, info, warn, error) and format (json, text).

| Key | Default | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `log.level` | `info` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_LOG_LEVEL` | One of debug, info, warn or error. |
| `log.format` | `json` | `SPACEMAN_AGENT_LOG_FORMAT` | One of json (ECS-aligned) or text. Logs go to stderr (the journal under systemd). |
